question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom:

**Not fit to hold a candle to**
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. "Greatly inferior to". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Not fit to hold a candle to"** means to be greatly inferior to someone or something in terms of quality, ability, or value. (किसी के तुलना में बहुत ही हीन होना) • **Example:** The new artist is talented, but he’s not fit to hold a candle to the legendary painter. • **"Greatly inferior to" **refers to being significantly less capable, valuable, or impressive in comparison to another. (काफी कमतर होना) • **Example:** His cooking skills are greatly inferior to those of a professional chef. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: Excellent in comparison** (तुलना में उत्कृष्ट): Refers to being significantly better than something or someone else. • **Example:** His performance was excellent in comparison to his previous attempts. • **Option 2: Similar in ability** (क्षमता में समान): Refers to two or more things or people having comparable levels of ability. • **Example:** The two athletes are similar in ability and often compete against each other. • **Option 4: Superior to in some aspects** (कुछ मामलों में श्रेष्ठ): Refers to being better in certain specific areas or qualities. • **Example:** This smartphone is superior to its competitors in terms of battery life. 38:Ta96, The correct answer is: **Stoic**.
